---
title: "Web apps & Websites"
css: "shiny.css"
---

```{r layout = "l-body-outset", results = "asis", echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x

render_examples <- function(yml, caption = TRUE, showcaseOnly = FALSE, shinyOnly = FALSE) {
    if (!requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop("Package 'yaml' is required to read examples.yml. Install with install.packages('yaml').")
    }
    if (!requireNamespace("htmltools", quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop("Package 'htmltools' is required to render examples. Install with install.packages('htmltools').")
    }

    items <- yaml::read_yaml(yml)
    if (length(items) == 0) return(invisible())

    items <- Filter(Negate(is.null), items)
    if (showcaseOnly) {
        items <- Filter(function(x) isTRUE(x$showcase), items)
    }
    if (shinyOnly) {
        items <- Filter(function(x) {
            href <- x$href %||% ""
            grepl("shiny", href, ignore.case = TRUE)
        }, items)
    }

    if (length(items) == 0) return(invisible())

    cat('<div class="row">')
    for (item in items) {
        title <- htmltools::htmlEscape(item$title %||% "")
        href <- htmltools::htmlEscape(item$href %||% "#")
        img <- htmltools::htmlEscape(item$img %||% "")

        cat('<div class="col-sm-4">')
        cat(sprintf('<a class="thumbnail" href="%s">', href))
        if (nzchar(img)) {
            cat(sprintf('<img src="%s" alt="%s"/>', img, title))
        }
        if (isTRUE(caption)) {
            cat(sprintf('<div class="caption">%s</div>', title))
        }
        cat('</a></div>')
    }
    cat('</div>')
}

render_examples(
    yml = "examples.yml",
    caption = TRUE,
    showcaseOnly = FALSE,
    shinyOnly = FALSE
)
```
